```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

##CIS1

file_path <- "CIS1_nt_abun.txt"
data <- read.table(file_path, header=TRUE, sep="", row.names=1)

data <- t(data)

data <- as.data.frame(data)

data$Position <- c("-6", "-5", "-4", "-3", "-2", "-1", "1", "2", "3", "4")  # Modify this based on your actual positions

df_melt <- melt(data, id.vars = 'Position', variable.name = 'Nucleotide', value.name = 'Frequency')

df_melt$Position <- factor(data$Position, levels = c("-6", "-5", "-4", "-3", "-2", "-1", "1", "2", "3", "4"))

df_melt$Nucleotide <- factor(df_melt$Nucleotide, levels = c('G', 'A', 'C', 'T'))

ggplot(df_melt, aes(x = as.factor(Position), y = Frequency, fill = Nucleotide)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', colour = "black") +  # Add black outline to each bar
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#90dbf4','#F28C9D','#F3E065','#9bb1ff')) + 
  labs(title = 'CIS1: Target Read', 
       x = 'Position', 
       y = 'Nucleotide Frequency') + 
  theme_minimal() + # Minimal theme for a clean white background 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),  # Center the title and set font size
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()  
  )

```
